providers.label: OpenRouter (many providers, one key)
providers.note: Model ids are creator/model; openrouter.ai/models lists them all.

providers.label: Ollama (models on your machine)
providers.note: Runs models on your machine: install Ollama (ollama.com), start it, and `ollama pull <model>` first. No API key.

providers.label: Vercel AI Gateway (many providers, one key)
providers.note: Model ids are creator/model; vercel.com/ai-gateway/models lists them all.

providers.label: Amazon Bedrock
providers.note: Instead of an access key, a Bedrock API key in AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK also works.

providers.label: Azure OpenAI
providers.note: The model is your Azure deployment name.

providers.label: Google Vertex AI
providers.note: Also needs Google credentials: run `gcloud auth application-default login`, or set GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS to a service-account key file.
